person.role: Archive Steward / department lead, THYLORA Global Archives & Places of Understanding
person.sheet_state: RECOVERY + PROPOSALS. PROPOSED values are not canon. NOT FOR PUBLIC REPORT until Chairman ruling (GATE-ALISTAIR-SOURCE / carryforward 589 decision b).

sources_read: thylora_world_entities: all 93 (ER-PLACE-BELL-CROSSING-001, ER-CASTLE-ROYAL-001, ER-CHAR-GUARDIAN-001, ER-CHAR-LEARNER-001, ER-NEWS-LOCAL-REPORTER-001, ER-PERSON-NORA-BELL-001)
thylora_graph_nodes / thylora_graph_edges / thylora_world_relationships / activation, exclusion, supersession, authenticity-check tables (searched: no Alistair rows)
rules_applied: Carryforward 589 / GATE-ALISTAIR-SOURCE: no town, street, spouse, child or animal in any public report until the Chairman rules. Every such field here is PROPOSED and flagged NOT FOR PUBLIC REPORT.
THY-PERSON-AUTHENTICITY-001: name, time, place, culture, language and role recorded and made to agree; the Scots-English name line is explained by migration.
THY-NAME-PROVENANCE-001: every proposed name has a stated source class (EdereAirah-original, Earth-style ordinary) and a collision check.
THY-MINOR-NAME-ADULT-USE-001: no protected name given to a child.
THY-LAND-INDIGENOUS-001: no land, nation, region, county or district invented; only a street (allowed target) is proposed.
THY-DUAL-TIME-EDEREARIAH-001/002: no native date invented; relative counts in orbits (507 Earth-read days) only.
Wage bands and REE: every amount is a ratio to P; no REE figure (bands rate null, REE smallest unit unset).
Institution registry: bank, treasury and regulator names are DO NOT GUESS; lender name left out.
no_random_face / appearance not default-assigned: face, body, height, weight UNKNOWN.
REF-532-02 is GRAMMAR_ONLY and is not read as household identity.
Ines template conventions: OPEN_IDENTITY slots for makers and staff not needed as named people; PROPOSED_NOT_CANON; ratio-only money; relative tenure.
time_region_protection_doctrine: equipment, services and transport match the proposed MODERN time-region.
Carryforward 590: neighbourhood life includes bad news (floods, theft, a dangerous road).
THY-CHILD-SAFE-001: children at the archive node never in a one-on-one adult session.
THY-WORK-INCLUSION-001: no religion or medical data recorded as personnel fact.
money_basis: P = one pay period of Alistair's base pay in REE (OPEN_AMOUNT: WAGE-BAND-RECORDS.rate is null, REE smallest unit unset). Orbit = 507 Earth-read days (RECOVERED). Proposed pay period = 28 days, so pay periods per orbit = 507/28 = 18.107. Annual base A = 18.107P. All money is in units of P; nothing is written in REE.

full_name.basis: program_registry THY-GLOBAL-ARCHIVE-PLACES-001 scope.lead (entered 2026-08-28); thylora_person_identity alistair-crowe canonical_name, WORLD_ACTIVE

pronunciation.value: AL-iss-ter KROH (two syllables then one; stress on AL). Written form locked as Alistair; Alastair/Allistair/Alister are voice variants only.
pronunciation.basis: Open field in thylora_person_identity.unknown_fields. Style copied from person_name_pronunciation_lock (ver-NEE-duh). Voice variants taken from thy_omniview_topics aliases (ALASTAIR, ALLISTAIR, ALISTER).

birth_date_or_year.value: Not recorded. No native date can be written.
birth_date_or_year.basis: thylora_world_time_profiles THY-DUAL-TIME-EDEREARIAH-001/002: native month/day/year numbering unresolved, never_fabricate_native_time = true. Same treatment as the learner dossier (birth state UNKNOWN).

age.basis: Peers carry an age on the life registry (Ines 55, Clara 61, Maren Rowan 62, Denise Carter 41). 46 fits a department lead with school-age children. Only aging may change it once locked.

sex.basis: Alistair is a masculine given name, and the open-field list for him names a 'wife' (thylora_execution_work_registry THY-WORK-ALISTAIR-HOUSEHOLD-RECOVERY-588 evidence.spine_589.open; thylora_person_identity 'wife or spouse').

time_region.basis: His period is an open field (thylora_person_identity). The program is world_layer DUAL and modern in shape (central index, provenance records). MODERN is one of the authorised time-regions (time_region_protection_doctrine; household_role_registry HH-MOD-*). Bell Crossing is already used in MODERN (ER-PLACE-BELL-CROSSING-001.modern_story_use).

culture_and_language.value: Crowe family naming follows a Scots-English naming line (Earth-mirror description only). The biography explains it: his grandfather migrated to Bell Crossing from a northern upland region whose name is not yet sourced. Everyday language: the common tongue of Bell Crossing.
culture_and_language.basis: THY-PERSON-AUTHENTICITY-001: NAME, TIME, PLACE, CULTURE, LANGUAGE and ROLE must agree, and a mismatch is allowed only when the biography explains it (migration). THY-NAME-PROVENANCE-001: name source class = EdereAirah canonical name (recovered record).

appearance.value: Not designed. No face, complexion or hair is given.
appearance.basis: The house does not default-assign appearance (no_random_face; dossier ER-HH-HOMEWORK-001 section K). REF-532-02 is GRAMMAR_ONLY and must never be read back as household identity (thylora_reference_image_bindings; thylora_person_identity note).

height.basis: no_random_face = true extends to body (dossier ER-HH-HOMEWORK-001). Heights are set on a Chairman lock sheet (e.g. LOCK-ER-ROYAL-COOK-001 163 cm).

weight.basis: Same rule as height; weight ranges live on lock sheets (LOCK-ER-ROYAL-COOK-001 72-77 kg).

health_state.basis: Life-registry privacy_policy puts illness, treatment and medical state in MEDICAL_PRIVATE. THY-WORK-INCLUSION-001: do not record medical history unless the person discloses it for an authorised purpose.

habits.value: Writes the date and the source on anything before reading it. Walks the same route to work and back. Keeps a pocket notebook with an index at the back. Reads at the kitchen table after the children are in bed.
habits.basis: Grounded in the program's own habits: source_lane_required and interpretation_labeled_separately (program_registry protections).

temperament.value: Patient, exact, slow to conclude. Warm with families who bring in papers; stubborn with anyone who wants a record to say more than it does. Tends to say 'we do not know that yet' rather than guess.
temperament.basis: Matches peer style (mind_profile.temperament on thylora_person_life_registry) and the program rule earth_fact_requires_evidence.

ambitions.value: Give every mapped place in the world its own archive node and understanding node, starting with Bell Crossing. Train a deputy good enough that the archive never depends on him.
ambitions.basis: Program model (one archival node + one understanding node per place/country/era) and next_action 'assign deputy/redundant operators' (program_registry THY-GLOBAL-ARCHIVE-PLACES-001).

fears.value: A family record lost because only one person knew where it was. Being quoted as the source for something he only interpreted. River flooding reaching the ground-floor records.
fears.basis: Protections alistair_not_sole_authority and multiple_operators_required; interpretation_labeled_separately (program_registry). Flood risk follows from a water-crossing town (land_naming_policy system A).

interests.value: Old ledgers and freight books; maps; river levels; mending bindings; the history of how Bell Crossing got its name.
interests.basis: Bell Crossing canon is a freight and trail town (ER-PLACE-BELL-CROSSING-001 evidence: Twelve Miles flour trail).

worship_or_belief.basis: No EdereAirah faith, church or observance exists in canon to attach him to; inventing one is world-level invention. THY-WORK-INCLUSION-001 also bars recording religion as a personnel fact without disclosure.

politics_and_governance_views.value: Believes no single person should hold the only key to a public record; that local records should stay where they belong and be linked, not carried off; that an unknown should be written as unknown. Party affiliation not recorded.
politics_and_governance_views.basis: Program protections alistair_not_sole_authority, multiple_operators_required; model 'central index links them without erasing local context' (program_registry). No EdereAirah party system exists, so party is left out.

personal_values.value: Provenance before story. Keep the family's words as they were said. Separate what is known from what is interpreted. Never make someone look important only because the record needs a hero.
personal_values.basis: Program protections (source_lane_required, interpretation_labeled_separately, no_fake_indigenous_history) and the Unkle Seezin continuity rule (never give a character means only because the story needs them).

exact_department.value: THYLORA Global Archives & Places of Understanding (program THY-GLOBAL-ARCHIVE-PLACES-001, category ARCHIVE_AND_PROVENANCE, status IMPLEMENTATION_ACTIVE)

department_code_link.basis: The program category equals an existing department_code. No row links them yet.

formal_office_title_beyond_archive_stewa.value: Chief Archive Steward, Global Archives & Places of Understanding
formal_office_title_beyond_archive_stewa.basis: program_registry unresolved: 'Exact Alistair Crowe office title beyond Archive Steward remains open'.

boss.basis: The program's authority is 'Chairman Vyctor Peete' (program_registry). No intermediate manager is recorded.

direct_reports.value: Two role slots, names OPEN: (1) Deputy Archive Steward, required so he is never the only operator; (2) Bell Crossing node archivist. The family-archive role architecture (Family Archive Steward, Document Organization Worker, Photo and Video Preservation Worker, Correction and Dispute Reviewer) is the pool to fill from.
direct_reports.basis: Protections multiple_operators_required and alistair_not_sole_authority; next_action 'assign deputy/redundant operators' (program_registry). family_archive_workers: 12 roles, all not_hired. Slots are left OPEN_IDENTITY, following the Ines wardrobe convention of no invented makers.

salary.value: WAGE-BAND-RECORDS, top step for a department lead. P = one pay period of Alistair's base pay in REE (OPEN_AMOUNT: WAGE-BAND-RECORDS.rate is null, REE smallest unit unset). Orbit = 507 Earth-read days (RECOVERED). Proposed pay period = 28 days, so pay periods per orbit = 507/28 = 18.107. Annual base A = 18.107P. No REE figure is written.
salary.basis: thylora_wage_bands WAGE-BAND-RECORDS (rate null, rate_state OPEN_AMOUNT, CHAIRMAN_DECISION_REQUIRED, earth_wage_claim false). Band is DERIVED from role class RECORDS; step and pay period are PROPOSED. Same ratio-only method as CAL-WAGE-BAND-COOK (branch origin/claude/ines-morales-complete-person-e1ujr4:db/edereairah/0001_ines_life_economy_575.sql).

bonus.value: One completion award per orbit when the node audit closes with no unexplained gaps: 0.5P. As a share of base: 0.5 / 18.107 = 2.76%.
bonus.basis: No bonus structure exists in canon. Tied to an audit outcome, not to output volume, so it cannot reward inventing records.

work_history.value: Began as a clerk in the Bell Crossing freight office's ledger room; moved into the town records office; spent some years cataloguing family papers for households along the river; named lead when the Global Archives program opened.
work_history.basis: Connects to recovered Bell Crossing roles: freight office (Nora Bell, ER-PERSON-NORA-BELL-001) and municipal records (Maren Rowan, ER-CHAR-GUARDIAN-001). No year is given (native calendar not locked).

employment_start_with_company.value: In the record since the program was registered (Earth custody timestamp 2026-08-28). No in-world date.
employment_start_with_company.basis: program_registry created_at 2026-08-28 and metadata.chairman_source '2026-08-28 spine'. An in-world start date would need the native calendar.

why_he_joined.value: The town's records were in three buildings and one of them flooded. He wanted them linked without being moved away, which is exactly the program's model.
why_he_joined.basis: Program model: 'central index links them without erasing local context' (program_registry).

daily_schedule.value: Up before the children; walks Isla and Callum part of the way to school; at the archive node by the start of the working day; morning on intake and cataloguing; midday walk by the river; afternoon on the central index and correspondence; home for the evening meal; one hour of reading after. One late day per cycle for families who can only come after work.
daily_schedule.basis: Pattern copied from the Ines off-duty/schedule rows (segment-based, no Earth clock hours). Hours are not given because native sub-day units are unresolved (thylora_world_time_profiles).

responsibilities.value: Maintain distributed archives and places of understanding by world/place/country/era/time context. Record sets: family archives, production provenance, place history, era sources, interpretation sheets, unknown/conflict queue. Build the archive node registry from existing places and productions; connect the lineage/title source lane and production understanding sheets; assign deputies.

equipment.value: Acid-free boxes and folders; cotton gloves; a flatbed scanner and a camera stand at the node; a work laptop on the THYLORA archive index; a moisture meter for the ground-floor store; a pocket notebook.
equipment.basis: MODERN time-region equipment (time_region_protection_doctrine: equipment must match the period).

credential_or_wearable.value: World credential CRED-ALISTAIR-CROWE-001 (proposed): world_title 'Archive Steward', issuing body THYLORA Global Archives & Places of Understanding, earth_license_claimed false. Wearable: a plain brass steward's pin with the archive index mark, worn on the lapel; photo card on a lanyard inside the records store only.
credential_or_wearable.basis: Open field 'historical employee credential or wearable' (thylora_person_identity). Format copied from thylora_world_credential_continuum (CRED-NADIR-COLE-001 etc.). Chairman 588 asked for period-evolving employee wearables; only the MODERN form is proposed.

commute.value: A walk of a few minutes from Tollhouse Lane to the records building by the crossing. Distance not measured.
commute.basis: Follows from the proposed worksite and address. Measurement stays UNKNOWN, as with the Ines routes (measurement_state UNKNOWN).

worksite.value: The Bell Crossing archive node, on the upper floor of the town records building (ground floor holds the municipal records office where Maren Rowan works).
worksite.basis: Program unresolved: 'Physical/archive locations remain to be mapped by place'. Maren Rowan's occupation 'Bell Crossing municipal records clerk' is RECOVERED (ER-CHAR-GUARDIAN-001); the shared building is proposed.

spouse.value: Elspeth Crowe (née Galbraith), 44. Dispensary pharmacist at the Bell Crossing dispensary, four days in five.
spouse.basis: Open field 'wife or spouse'. Name follows the same Scots-English line (THY-PERSON-AUTHENTICITY-001). Dispensary work ties to the Chairman's 588 dispensary/customer-service continuity lane. Collision check: 'Elspeth' and 'Galbraith' appear in none of 17 person tables. NOT FOR PUBLIC REPORT until Chairman ruling (GATE-ALISTAIR-SOURCE / carryforward 589 decision b).

children.basis: Open field 'children'. Neither name is a protected name (THY-MINOR-NAME-ADULT-USE-001 reserves e.g. Daniel; locked family names Jordan, Cali, Kennedy, Kylie, Victoria, Wyck avoided). No collision in 17 person tables. NOT FOR PUBLIC REPORT until Chairman ruling (GATE-ALISTAIR-SOURCE / carryforward 589 decision b).

children_ages.basis: School ages consistent with the Bell Crossing school already implied by ER-EDU-LMS-001. NOT FOR PUBLIC REPORT until Chairman ruling (GATE-ALISTAIR-SOURCE / carryforward 589 decision b).

relatives_nearby.value: His mother, Agnes Crowe, 72, widowed, in her own small house on the other side of the crossing. Elspeth's family live elsewhere (place not named).
relatives_nearby.basis: Nearest-connected relative. 'Agnes' has no collision. NOT FOR PUBLIC REPORT until Chairman ruling (GATE-ALISTAIR-SOURCE / carryforward 589 decision b).

pets.value: One household dog, older, from a neighbour's litter. Name withheld from any public report.
pets.basis: Open field 'animal'. The 589 constraint forbids naming an animal publicly. NOT FOR PUBLIC REPORT until Chairman ruling (GATE-ALISTAIR-SOURCE / carryforward 589 decision b).

native_animals.basis: No EdereAirah fauna canon exists; the animal-ecology channel is only a 588 direction. Naming a native species would be world-level invention.

friends.value: Taren Mercer (Provenance & Naming Steward) as his closest colleague-friend; Denise Carter (local correspondent) as a friendly acquaintance who checks facts with him.
friends.basis: Both people are RECOVERED (thylora_department_personnel THY-FLAG-PER-004; thylora_person_life_registry ER-NEWS-LOCAL-REPORTER-001, base_settlement Bell Crossing). Only the friendships are proposed.

neighbors.value: The Fenwick household next door (Ewan Fenwick, ferry and bridge maintenance; Mairi Fenwick, grocer's bookkeeper) and an elderly widower across the lane, Hollis (surname), who keeps river-level notes.
neighbors.basis: New people, names checked: Fenwick, Ewan, Mairi, Hollis have no collisions. 'Marr' and 'Pryce' were rejected because they already appear. The Rowan household is NOT made a neighbour: its household row says no neighbour may be added to that scene. NOT FOR PUBLIC REPORT until Chairman ruling (GATE-ALISTAIR-SOURCE / carryforward 589 decision b).

household_employees.value: None. The family does its own cleaning and cooking; Agnes helps with the children after school two days a cycle.
household_employees.basis: A single records-band salary plus a part-time pharmacist income does not carry staff (see household economy).

country.basis: THY-LAND-INDIGENOUS-001: nations and lands must use sourced Indigenous self-names or separately approved names, never invention. Bell Crossing parent_land is UNKNOWN (ER-PLACE-BELL-CROSSING-001).

state_or_province_equivalent.basis: Same policy: major regions are not invented. Bell Crossing parent_region is UNKNOWN.

county_equivalent.basis: land_naming_policy allows 'selected counties/local jurisdictions when approved' only. None is approved.

city_or_town.basis: The settlement is RECOVERED canon (thylora_world_entities ER-PLACE-BELL-CROSSING-001, CANON_RECOVERED_FROM_STORY_TEXT). Placing Alistair there is proposed. NOT FOR PUBLIC REPORT until Chairman ruling (GATE-ALISTAIR-SOURCE / carryforward 589 decision b).

block.value: Third block up from the crossing, river side of Tollhouse Lane (a position, not a name).
block.basis: Block is described by position so no district name is invented. NOT FOR PUBLIC REPORT until Chairman ruling (GATE-ALISTAIR-SOURCE / carryforward 589 decision b).

parcel.value: BC-PCL-TOLL-014 (an internal registry identifier, not a place name)
parcel.basis: Code pattern follows existing registry codes (LAND-HERB-KITCHEN-001, THT-CLASS-*). NOT FOR PUBLIC REPORT until Chairman ruling (GATE-ALISTAIR-SOURCE / carryforward 589 decision b).

address.basis: Streets are an allowed original-naming target (land_naming_policy.allowed_naming_targets). 'Tollhouse' fits Bell Crossing's water-and-crossing naming system A; no collision found. NOT FOR PUBLIC REPORT until Chairman ruling (GATE-ALISTAIR-SOURCE / carryforward 589 decision b).

postal_code_equivalent.basis: No postal authority or code system exists in canon; inventing one is a world-level system.

house_construction_date.value: Built about 60 orbits before the present (a count, not a calendar date).
house_construction_date.basis: Native calendar not locked; relative form follows the Ines tenure convention (PWS-P-TENURE: 'Do not fix a date. Fix a relation').

architect_or_builder.value: A Bell Crossing builder's yard of the time; identity OPEN.
architect_or_builder.basis: Kept as an OPEN_IDENTITY slot, following the no-invented-makers rule (branch ines-morales: thylora_wardrobe_supply_chain).

construction_crew.value: Builder's yard crew plus a river mason for the stone footing; identities OPEN.
construction_crew.basis: Same slot convention. A stone footing follows from a flood-prone river town.

original_cost.value: Bought by Alistair and Elspeth 12 orbits ago. Purchase price, expressed in today's P: 0.7 x current value = 0.7 x 72.43P = 50.70P. Original build cost 60 orbits ago: not recoverable.
original_cost.basis: Ratio-only, because REE has no smallest unit. 0.7 = assumed appreciation over 12 orbits.

current_value.basis: Ratio to his own pay, as CAL-DRESS-COST does for Ines.

mortgage_or_debt.value: Loan = 0.8 x purchase = 0.8 x 50.70P = 40.56P over 25 orbits. After 12 orbits, principal left (level principal) = (1 - 12/25) x 40.56P = 21.09P. Principal per pay period = 40.56P / (25 x 18.107) = 0.0896P, about 9.0% of a pay period, plus interest (rate OPEN). Lender: a personal bank (INST-PERSONAL-BANK-001 class); name not given.
mortgage_or_debt.basis: Lender class DERIVED from thylora_world_institution_registry INST-PERSONAL-BANK-001; its canonical_name is 'OPEN — NO CANON NAME (DO NOT GUESS)', so no name is written.

insurance.value: Buildings and flood cover at 0.4% of value per orbit = 0.004 x 72.43P = 0.29P per orbit. Insurer identity OPEN.

taxes_and_fees.basis: No tax authority exists in canon; INST-ROYAL-TREASURY-001 lists 'relationship to any tax authority' as OPEN.

utilities_overall.value: Town water, town sewer, grid power, piped heat or a household boiler, phone and network line. About 6% of household income.
utilities_overall.basis: MODERN time-region services (time_region_protection_doctrine; HH-MOD-FACILITIES duties include utilities).

water.value: Town supply drawn from the river above the crossing and treated before use.

heat.value: A household boiler with radiators; a wood stove in the kitchen kept for power cuts.
heat.basis: Second path when the first fails (Life-First equation R = redundancy, MATH-L-001, WR-SPINE-589).

power.value: Town grid; a small battery lamp set for flood nights.

sanitation.value: Town sewer; refuse collected once a cycle; compost in the yard.

communications.value: Landline, household network, work phone for the archive node.

meals.value: Porridge and tea early; a packed lunch eaten by the river; the family eats together in the evening, Elspeth and Alistair alternating the cooking.
meals.basis: Ordinary household pattern; no world canon on cuisine.

favorite_foods.value: Smoked river fish, oat bread, a thick barley soup his mother makes.

rest.value: One full rest day in seven; he does not open the archive on it unless a flood threatens the store.
rest.basis: Relief pattern copied from REL-INES-001 (one relief day in seven service-cycle days, recall only as a named exception).

vacations.value: A few days each orbit upriver with the children; no destination named.
vacations.basis: Places beyond Bell Crossing cannot be named (THY-LAND-INDIGENOUS-001).

entertainment.value: Radio in the kitchen; board games with the children; the town's yearly crossing observance.
entertainment.basis: Community event proposed, not a sourced town event.

local_shops.value: A grocer (where Mairi Fenwick keeps the books), the dispensary (where Elspeth works), a hardware and chandlery by the landing, and the freight office run by Nora Bell.
local_shops.basis: Nora Bell's freight role is RECOVERED (ER-PERSON-NORA-BELL-001); the shop list is proposed.

doctors.value: The town general-practice clinic; physician identity OPEN.
doctors.basis: Slot only; no physician is invented.

hospital.value: A regional hospital outside Bell Crossing, reached by road ambulance; name and location OPEN.
hospital.basis: Chairman 588 physician/ambulance life-first design implies a hospital route; the region cannot be named.

school.value: The Bell Crossing school (the same school implied for the learner in ER-EDU-LMS-001).
school.basis: ER-PLACE-BELL-CROSSING-001: a Bell Crossing school two generations after the trail story is 'coherent, but a Chairman decision'. NOT FOR PUBLIC REPORT until Chairman ruling (GATE-ALISTAIR-SOURCE / carryforward 589 decision b).

childrens_school_travel.value: On foot, down Tollhouse Lane and along the river path; Alistair walks with them part of the way; Isla walks Callum home.
childrens_school_travel.basis: Follows from address and school. NOT FOR PUBLIC REPORT until Chairman ruling (GATE-ALISTAIR-SOURCE / carryforward 589 decision b).

after_school_life.value: Callum at his grandmother's two days a cycle; Isla helps at the archive node on her own terms, labelling boxes; both in a river-safety swim class.
after_school_life.basis: Any time a child is at the node, THY-CHILD-SAFE-001 applies: no one-on-one adult session; two-adult coverage. NOT FOR PUBLIC REPORT until Chairman ruling (GATE-ALISTAIR-SOURCE / carryforward 589 decision b).

neighborhood_safety.value: Mostly safe, not perfect: the river floods low streets in bad seasons; there is petty theft at the freight yard; the road by the landing is fast and has no crossing guard.
neighborhood_safety.basis: Carryforward 590: EdereAirah is not utopian; bad news, accidents and crime are required in living history.

worship_or_community_places.value: Community: the town hall and the landing where the crossing observance is held. Worship place: not recorded.
worship_or_community_places.basis: Worship left out for the same reason as worship_or_belief (no faith canon).

library.value: The Bell Crossing public reading room, sharing the records building with the archive node.

parks.value: The riverside green above the crossing.

transportation.value: Walking in town; the regional road for anything further; the ferry or bridge at the crossing.

vehicles.value: One used family estate car, make not named; two bicycles.
vehicles.basis: Open field 'vehicle'. No make is named (er_automotive_naming_corrections governs vehicle names).

household_economy.value: Household income H = Alistair base A (18.107P) + bonus (0.5P) + Elspeth S (0.75 x A = 13.580P) = 32.188P per orbit. Proposed shares of H: housing (principal + interest + insurance) 24%, food 18%, utilities 6%, transport 7%, children 10%, help to Agnes 5%, savings 12%, everything else 18% (sum 100%).
household_economy.basis: Ratio-only, as in the Ines template. S = 0.75A is a proposal for a four-day pharmacist; no band covers it.

why_the_family_came.value: His grandfather came to keep the freight ledgers at the crossing when the town's traffic grew.
why_the_family_came.basis: Bell Crossing freight/trail canon (ER-PLACE-BELL-CROSSING-001 evidence; ER-PERSON-NORA-BELL-001 freight office). Also supplies the migration explanation THY-PERSON-AUTHENTICITY-001 requires for the Scots-English name line. NOT FOR PUBLIC REPORT until Chairman ruling (GATE-ALISTAIR-SOURCE / carryforward 589 decision b).

generations_in_place.value: Three: grandfather, father, Alistair (the children are the fourth).
generations_in_place.basis: NOT FOR PUBLIC REPORT until Chairman ruling (GATE-ALISTAIR-SOURCE / carryforward 589 decision b).

where_previous_relatives_lived.value: A northern upland region; its name is not sourced and is not written.
where_previous_relatives_lived.basis: The fact of migration is proposed; the place name stays unwritten under THY-LAND-INDIGENOUS-001.

major_family_events.value: Grandfather's arrival; the flood that damaged the old records store (the reason Alistair took up archive work); his father's death; his marriage to Elspeth; buying 14 Tollhouse Lane; Isla and Callum born; his appointment as program lead.
major_family_events.basis: Only the appointment is backed by a record (program_registry). No dates: native calendar not locked. NOT FOR PUBLIC REPORT until Chairman ruling (GATE-ALISTAIR-SOURCE / carryforward 589 decision b).

relationship_to_surrounding_area.value: Known on the river side of town as the man who will look after your family papers and give them back. Linked by work to the records office, the freight office and the local correspondent.
relationship_to_surrounding_area.basis: Ties to recovered Bell Crossing people (Maren Rowan, Nora Bell, Denise Carter).

local_history_recovered.value: Bell Crossing is canon from the Twelve Miles story ('Ride to Bell Crossing. Bring flour, lamp oil, salt...'); the name follows the WATER AND CROSSING system; its historical time-region is an open conflict; it persists into MODERN for ER-EDU-LMS-001.

local_economy_present.value: Freight and river trade, a grocer, a dispensary, the town records office, the school, and small river works (bridge and ferry maintenance).
local_economy_present.basis: Extends the recovered freight economy into MODERN.

unknown_fields.why_unknown: Native calendar (month, day, year numbering) is unresolved and never_fabricate_native_time is set.
unknown_fields.what_would_resolve_it: Chairman locks the native calendar, or accepts an age-only record.

unknown_fields.why_unknown: The house does not default-assign faces, complexion or hair; REF-532-02 is grammar only.
unknown_fields.what_would_resolve_it: A Chairman lock sheet (LOCK-ALISTAIR-CROWE-001) with face, hair and posture.
